headerDisplay: Expose camera snapshots as HomeKit motion sensors using on-device object detection. Add one **Snapshot** per source/camera, then add **Sensors** to it.
footerDisplay:
### How sensors work

Each **Sensor** becomes one HomeKit motion sensor that triggers when **any** of its selected categories is detected above the threshold.

- **Categories** — `animals`, `people`, `vehicles`. Select one or more; the sensor fires on any of them.
- **Name** — optional. Leave blank to auto-name it (prefixed with the snapshot name). A name you enter is used verbatim and must be unique across all snapshots.
- **Threshold** — optional confidence cutoff from 0–1 (default `0.5`). Lower = more sensitive, more false positives.
